typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @STARTDATE DATE=?, 		@ENDDATE DATE=? DECLARE @STARTDATE_REPORT DATE, 		@ENDDATE_REPORT DATE IF ((@STARTDATE = \'01/01/1900\' OR @STARTDATE IS NULL) and (@ENDDATE = \'01/01/1900\' OR @ENDDATE IS NULL)) BEGIN	 	SELECT @STARTDATE_REPORT =CAST(MONTH(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(02))+\'/25/\'+CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR (20)) ,  	       @ENDDATE_REPORT=DATEADD(s,1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,GETDATE())+1,0)) END ELSE BEGIN SELECT @STARTDATE_REPORT=@STARTDATE,@ENDDATE_REPORT=@ENDDATE END  SELECT \'"MEDICAID_ID"\' AS MEDICAID_ID,        \'"MEMBER_FIRST_NAME"\' AS MEMBER_FIRST_NAME, 	   \'"MEMBER_LAST_NAME"\' AS MEMBER_LAST_NAME,				 	   \'"DOB"\' AS DOB UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT \'"\'+UPPER(ME.[MEME_MEDCD_NO])+\'"\' AS MEDICAID_ID,                 \'"\'+UPPER(ME.[MEME_FIRST_NAME])+\'"\' AS MEMBER_FIRST_NAME, 				\'"\'+UPPER(ME.[MEME_LAST_NAME])+\'"\' AS MEMBER_LAST_NAME,				 				\'"\'+convert(varchar(8),cast(ME.[MEME_BIRTH_DT] as date),112)+\'"\' AS DOB				 FROM [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER](NOLOCK) ME INNER JOIN [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG](NOLOCK) MP ON ME.GRGR_CK=49 AND MP.MEME_CK=ME.MEME_CK AND  MEPE_ELIG_IND=\'Y\' AND MP.PDPD_ID=\'GAS00700\' AND MEPE_EFF_DT <= @ENDDATE_REPORTAND MEPE_TERM_DT>@STARTDATE_REPORTMONTH',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		DOB as string,
		MEDICAID_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		DOB,
		MEDICAID_ID)) ~> FlatFileDestination
